mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 64 degrees at Verona City Hall, though there is an elevated air quality index of 52. It is a beautiful night under the First Quarter moon, and if you are a space fan, the ISS will be visible for one minute starting at 3:23 AM, moving from the South over Belleville toward the East near Fitchburg.

The City of Verona has two big updates. First, the Public Works department is hiring an Engineering Technician to oversee infrastructure projects through September 20. Second, the city has a rain barrel rebate program offering thirty dollars back for eligible properties, and new sewer and stormwater utility rates were recently approved to ensure our systems remain self-supporting.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmer's Market takes over the Square in Madison, and you can also find live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly report, on Friday, August 15, a 44-year-old woman was arrested for an O W I after officers found her passed out behind the wheel near North Main Street and Cross Country Road.
Today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The shop is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
